content: {"paper_id":"lab-ec6acdec9eea","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"latent-reasoning","exact_quote":"We propose PLUME, a latent reasoning framework that advances UME by replacing verbalized CoT with a short autoregressive rollout of continuous latent states.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要明确提出 PLUME 是 latent reasoning 框架，用连续潜在状态的自回归 rollout 替代显式 CoT，属于以连续潜在状态执行中间推理。"},{"keyword_id":"multimodal-retrieval","exact_quote":"Universal multimodal embedding (UME) maps heterogeneous inputs into a shared retrieval space with a single model.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要开篇定义 UME 将异构输入映射到共享检索空间，且后文面向视频与视觉文档检索，符合多模态检索任务。"},{"keyword_id":"large-vision-language-models","exact_quote":"Recent approaches improve UME by generating explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) rationales before extracting embeddings, enabling multimodal large language models to better infer complex query intent.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要明确以 multimodal large language models 作为推理核心/组件，研究其显式 CoT 与潜在推理适配，符合视觉语言大模型证据。"}],"abstentions":[],"input_issues":[]}
